name: mcpSessions
description: Returns the live session ids for an MCP server as an array of strings, so a page can see which clients are connected and target one of them with mcpNotify( to= ). The server argument is optional inside a handler (it defaults to the server of the current call). When no server is running or no session matches, an empty array is returned.

params.name: server
params.description: The MCP server whose sessions to list, e.g. "/mcp/docs". Inside a handler this defaults to the server of the current call.

links.title: RustCFML MCP documentation
links.description: Full documentation of the RustCFML Model Context Protocol support.

examples.title: List the live sessions of a server
examples.description: Use mcpSessions() to see who is connected, then target a specific session with mcpNotify( to= ).
examples.code:
var sessions = mcpSessions( "/mcp/docs" );
writeOutput( "connected sessions: #arrayLen( sessions )#\n" );
examples.result: An array of session id strings; empty when nobody is connected.
